user.title: Connect TV
user.description:
Previously two remotes were needed: Bluetooth for the TV and infrared just for the optical Sonos Playbar volume. This integration uses the TV remote for volume, TV apps and Home Assistant actions. Physically tested: Xiaomi MiTV-MOEU0, Android TV 14, Xiaomi RC Consumer Control and Sonos Playbar. Other Android/Google TVs are unverified; LG/webOS and Samsung/Tizen are not supported.

**1. Prepare the TV**
Keep the TV on. Open Settings → System/Device preferences → About and press OK on Build/Android TV OS build seven times. Then open Developer options. Menu names vary by TV.

**2. Enable ADB on your home network**
On the tested Xiaomi, enable Mi TV ADB Debugging and complete any requested restart. Classic network ADB works over Ethernet or Wi-Fi, usually port 5555. USB debugging alone does not guarantee network access. Wireless debugging with a pairing code/TLS is not supported yet.

**3. Authorize Home Assistant**
Enter the TV IP from its network settings below. When connecting, select Always allow from this computer and Allow on the TV. The prompt may say Allow USB debugging even over Ethernet. Do not reset existing authorizations.

device.title: Select remote input
device.description: Recommended: enable Identify by key press and continue, then press Volume Down only when prompted. Or select manually. These are actual and virtual TV inputs, not a compatibility list. A match identifies one input; other buttons may use another input.

detect_start.title: Identify remote
detect_start.description: After Next, detection runs for 20 seconds. Briefly press and release **Volume Down**. No HA action runs; the TV itself may still react. Manual selection remains available if no unique signal is found.

finish.title: Connected — next steps
finish.description:
After finishing: **Settings → Devices & services → TV Sonos Remote Bridge → cog/Configure**. Visit configuration on the device page also leads there.

1. Open Set up TV app and deliberately choose installation.
2. Enable the **TV-Fernbedienungsbrücke** accessibility service on the TV.
3. Back in HA choose Learn / change button.

Volume works without the TV app. Connected — waiting for buttons describes the connection, not individual presses. Help remains available in Configure.

init.title: Set up remote

menu_options.helper: Set up TV app / transfer bindings

init.description: Order: set up TV app → enable accessibility on TV → learn a button and select its function. Volume only needs ADB. Close with × at any time; bindings change only when saved.

connection.title: Connection

data.volume_step: Step in percentage points (0 = device default, 1 = fine)

connection.description: 1 sets absolute volume in one-percentage-point steps; 0 retains native stepping. Sonos defaults to 2 and supports a minimum step of 1; levels below Sonos level 1 are unavailable. The TV bar shows its own output, not Sonos volume. The target entity and connection sensor attributes show reported volume and mute state.

learn.title: Learn key
learn.description: Within 60 seconds, press and release a key, then submit. HA actions are suppressed while capturing; existing local TV app mappings and original TV actions may still run.

helper.title: TV helper
helper.description: Installation updates the TV app to bundled version 1.7.1 and opens it. Then enable accessibility on the TV. Without installation only bindings are transferred. Both replace existing app bindings; downgrade is not guaranteed. Signature conflicts never trigger automatic uninstall.

guide.title: Instructions
guide.description:
Previously two remotes were needed: Bluetooth for the TV and infrared just for the optical Sonos Playbar volume. This integration uses the TV remote for volume, TV apps and Home Assistant actions. Physically tested: Xiaomi MiTV-MOEU0, Android TV 14, Xiaomi RC Consumer Control and Sonos Playbar. Other Android/Google TVs are unverified; LG/webOS and Samsung/Tizen are not supported.

**1. Prepare the TV**
Keep the TV on. Open Settings → System/Device preferences → About and press OK on Build/Android TV OS build seven times. Then open Developer options. Menu names vary by TV.

**2. Enable ADB on your home network**
On the tested Xiaomi, enable Mi TV ADB Debugging and complete any requested restart. Classic network ADB works over Ethernet or Wi-Fi, usually port 5555. USB debugging alone does not guarantee network access. Wireless debugging with a pairing code/TLS is not supported yet.

**3. Authorize Home Assistant**
Enter the TV IP from its network settings below. When connecting, select Always allow from this computer and Allow on the TV. The prompt may say Allow USB debugging even over Ethernet. Do not reset existing authorizations.

**Next:** Set up TV app → select installation → on TV open accessibility settings → enable TV-Fernbedienungsbrücke → return to HA → learn a button. The TV app can stay in the background. Disable its accessibility service to stop app remapping; disable the HA integration separately to stop volume control.

helper_ready.title: Transferred — enable on TV
helper_ready.description:
On the TV: **Open accessibility settings → TV-Fernbedienungsbrücke → On**, confirm access. Press Back to leave the app; it works in the background.

Finish here, then open **Learn / change button** in Configure. Instructions remain available in the TV app and Instructions and tested devices.

detect_start.title: Identify remote
detect_start.description: After Next, detection runs for 20 seconds. Briefly press and release **Volume Down**. No HA action runs; the TV itself may still react. Manual selection remains available if no unique signal is found.

detect_result.title: Confirm detected input
detect_result.description: The existing reader was paused only for detection and resumes afterwards. Save to apply this input. Volume Down identifies the volume input; other buttons may use a different input. Failed detection preserves the previous name.

press.title: Choose press type
press.description: Assign single, double or long press separately. Each key uses either TV apps or HA actions/events; remove old bindings on that key to change owner. Double: within 350 ms after release; long: hold 750 ms. Single waits when double/long is assigned. Volume hold is unchanged. Requires TV app 1.7.

function.title: Choose function
function.description: HA action executes a command on a selected entity, such as toggling a light or activating a scene. HA event only reports the press; a separate automation must react to it. TV app opens a local app. Next shows only the relevant fields.

action.title: Choose action
action.description: Choose an action, then select its target entity on the next screen. For brightness, multiple actions, devices, areas or YAML choose Advanced action sequence. Existing actions default to the sequence editor to preserve all parameters.

binding_event.title: Key {code} · {press}
binding_event.description: Only emits `{event}` with `button` = name, `scan_code` = {code}, `press` = {press}, and `entry_id`. No entity is controlled. Create a separate event-triggered automation, or choose HA action for direct control.

binding_action.title: Key {code} · {press}
binding_action.description: Key {code} ({press}) directly runs **{action}** on the target entities selected below. A button event is also emitted: avoid a second automation performing the same action. Saving transfers all bindings.

binding_app.title: Key {code} · {press}
binding_app.description: Opens the selected TV app locally. Saving transfers all bindings. Keep TV on and accessibility enabled; original TV actions can only be suppressed for keys delivered to the service.

binding_none.title: Remove binding
binding_none.description: Removes only {press} for key {code}; other press types are retained.

binding_sequence.title: Key {code} · {press}
binding_sequence.description: This sequence runs directly on key {code} ({press}). Choose an action and its target inside the editor; parameters such as brightness are available there. A button event is also emitted: avoid a second automation performing the same action. Saving transfers all bindings.
